title: Lao PDR national health portal and gateway (Country B, XXH)
description: Lao PDR's national FHIR server behind the OHS FHIR Info Gateway (J4.0, J4.1): assembles each family member's IPS and DVCs, issues each as a passcode-protected Verifiable Health Link in an HCERT signed with Country B's DSC, hosts the manifests (ITI-YY5), checks passcode, expiry and consent on each request, and logs every access as an AuditEvent at home. Country B is played on the GDHCN DEV network by the fictional participant XXH, so no real ministry's key is implied.

parts.title: FHIR record server
parts.description: Holds each person's records (IPS, DVCs) as FHIR resources, from which the portal assembles what a VHL shares (J4.0, J4.1).

parts.title: VHL issuer
parts.description: Issues a passcode-protected Verifiable Health Link per family member, in an HCERT signed with Lao PDR's document signer key (J4.0).

parts.title: Information gateway and access log (OHS)
parts.description: Answers a VHL manifest request after checking its signature, the passcode, the expiry and the consent, and logs each access in Lao PDR (J4.1).

parts.title: Client registry (children, households)
parts.description: Identifies each person the portal serves, children and their households included.

parts.title: Facility registry (clinics, health centres)
parts.description: Lists the clinics and health centres that record and share care.

parts.title: Health workforce registry (CHWs, nurses)
parts.description: Lists the health workers, community health workers and nurses among them, who record care.

parts.title: Analytics pipeline (OHS FHIR Data Pipes)
parts.description: Copies the portal's FHIR data into an analytics store for reporting.
